$comment: Launcher manifest for the faster-bag-tying mod. This file only DESCRIBES the mod; the value store stays the live %LOCALAPPDATA%\LeafItAloneSafe\faster-bag-tying.json that apply.ps1 seeds and reads, and apply/revert run the validated scripts. Adding a mod means writing a manifest like this, never new launcher UI code.
name: Faster bag tying
description: Makes tying a full leaf bag faster by lowering the base tying time on every bag, from the start instead of waiting for the in-game upgrades. Choose a simple fraction of the vanilla tying time, or set each bag's seconds explicitly. Optionally speed up bag emptying (dumping) too.

fields.label: Sizing mode
fields.help: multiplier scales the vanilla tying times (small 1.0s, medium 1.35s, big 1.7s, giant 1.8s); seconds sets each bag explicitly.

fields.label: Tying-time fraction
fields.help: Fraction of the vanilla tying time. 0.5 = half the time (2x faster); 1 = no change.

fields.label: Also speed up bag emptying (dumping)
fields.help: Applies the same speed-up ratio to the emptying/dumping time (vanilla 0.8/1.1/1.4/1.5s).

$patchesComment: 2b conflict detection (from patch_faster_bag_tying.py): rewrites the LeafBagBehaviourSettings.sealingTime on the four bag actors in the coreassets ACTORS bundle (and, only when alsoEmptying is on, emptyingDuration). Different bundle AND different field than bag-capacity's meta-bundle capacity ints, so the two bag mods correctly never report a conflict.
